name: mitaoe-campus-carpool
description: MITAOE Campus Carpool — Intra-Campus Ride Sharing Platform (MERN)

scripts.test:all: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
scripts.build: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install --include=dev && npm run build && cd ..
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.deploy:prepare: npm run install:all && npm run build && npm run test:all
